options.name: authenticateBeforeCRLReceived
options.description: Switch to enable or disable CRL verification if CRL is not received.

options.name: automaticCRLUpdate
options.description: Switch to enable or disable automatic CRL update.

options.name: automaticCRLUpdatePeriod
options.description: Automatic CRL update period.

options.name: automaticCRLUpdateUnits
options.description: Unit of time for automatic CRL update.

options.name: crlDistributionUrl
options.description: CRL Distribution URL.

options.name: crlDownloadFailureRetries
options.description: If CRL download fails, wait time before retry.

options.name: crlDownloadFailureRetriesUnits
options.description: Unit of time before retry if CRL download fails.

options.name: description
options.description: Description for trust certificate.

options.name: downloadCRL
options.description: Switch to enable or disable download of CRL.

options.name: enableOCSPValidation
options.description: Switch to enable or disable OCSP Validation.

options.name: enableServerIdentityCheck
options.description: Switch to enable or disable verification if HTTPS or LDAP server certificate name fits the configured server URL.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. ID of the trust certificate.

options.name: ignoreCRLExpiration
options.description: Switch to enable or disable ignore CRL expiration.

options.name: ise_debug
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: ise_hostname
options.description: The Identity Services Engine hostname.

options.name: ise_password
options.description: The Identity Services Engine password to authenticate.

options.name: ise_single_request_timeout
options.description: Timeout (in seconds) for RESTful HTTP requests.

options.name: ise_username
options.description: The Identity Services Engine username to authenticate.

options.name: ise_uses_api_gateway
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether to use the Identity Services Engine's API Gateway to send requests. If it is true, it uses the ISE's API Gateway and sends requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}. If it is false, it sends the requests to https://{{ise_hostname}}:{{port}}, where the port value depends on the Service used (ERS, Mnt, UI, PxGrid).

options.name: ise_uses_csrf_token
options.description: Flag that informs the SDK whether we send the CSRF token to ISE's ERS APIs. If it is True, the SDK assumes that your ISE CSRF Check is enabled. If it is True, it assumes you need the SDK to manage the CSRF token automatically for you.

options.name: ise_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: ise_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Identity Services Engine to use.

options.name: ise_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: Flag for Identity Services Engine SDK to enable automatic rate-limit handling.

options.name: name
options.description: Friendly name of the certificate.

options.name: nonAutomaticCRLUpdatePeriod
options.description: Non automatic CRL update period.

options.name: nonAutomaticCRLUpdateUnits
options.description: Unit of time of non automatic CRL update.

options.name: rejectIfNoStatusFromOCSP
options.description: Switch to reject certificate if there is no status from OCSP.

options.name: rejectIfUnreachableFromOCSP
options.description: Switch to reject certificate if unreachable from OCSP.

options.name: selectedOCSPService
options.description: Name of selected OCSP Service.

options.name: status
options.description: Trusted Certificate's status.

options.name: trustForCertificateBasedAdminAuth
options.description: Trust for Certificate based Admin authentication.

options.name: trustForCiscoServicesAuth
options.description: Trust for authentication of Cisco Services.

options.name: trustForClientAuth
options.description: Trust for client authentication and Syslog.

options.name: trustForIseAuth
options.description: Trust for authentication within Cisco ISE.
